applicationCategory: Batch file upload to Wikimedia Commons

affiliation.name: Sant'Anna School of Advanced Studies, Pisa

description: Commons Uploader is a Python script that uploads batches of photographs to Wikimedia Commons from a spreadsheet generated with Pattypan. It previews the file description pages, validates the spreadsheet, reads the camera model from EXIF data, supports the personality rights notice, and never stores passwords.
name: Commons Uploader
